## Episode Thesis

This is a geopolitical episode with Joakim Paasikivi, senior geopolitical adviser at Mannheimer Swartling. He argues the US has no clear plan in its conflict with Iran and sees no quick end to it; Iran is still able to disrupt shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, which weighs on oil prices and on US credibility. He expects the Russia-Ukraine war to continue without peace this year, with Russia pursuing hybrid warfare against Europe, although he calls European and Nordic-Baltic unity and rearmament encouraging. No listed equities are discussed; the only company names come from the guest's employer, a news source and sponsor ads.
